verdict.rationale: GlitchTip accepts error data from Sentry's open-source SDKs, aims for Sentry API compatibility, and lets users inspect stack traces and event data. Community users confirm the Sentry reporting libraries work reliably with it. That implies developers can instrument events through those SDKs, but no evidence specifically says GlitchTip ingests or shows breadcrumbs, custom tags, or user context. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that breadcrumbs, tags, and user context are received and displayed on events, plus hands-on confirmation that this state appears alongside stack traces.
